text_block_list.text: Goodness me... Cheer up, Flower.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
But they were counting on me, and I
wasn't able
to follow through...
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text: Well, yes... kind of.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Нишино Флауэр was asked to

embroider a floral design onto a
handkerchief as
a gift for her friend's
mother.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I used the wrong color, but I only
realized it after
I had already started
embroidering...
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text: Sniffle... What do I do? My friend asks me for help, and I end up ruining everything...
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text: There, there, it's okay. I've got an idea.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
If we add a pattern using the color you

accidentally used, it'll make a nice
background
for the actual flower...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: W-wow! This looks great!
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank goodness.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Creek! You really
are
incredible.
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text:
You're always so calm and kind—not to
mention
knowledgeable about all sorts
of things...
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I still have a long way to go if I ever want to catch up to you...
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text:
I wish I was as calm, dependable, and
wonderful
an Umamusume as you.
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text:
Gosh, I'm sure you'll be far more
amazing than me
when you grow up.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Th-that's not true! I mean... I'm still...
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, then I'll just have to prove it to
you! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You're the one who grew those flowers
over
there, right?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Y-yes...
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text:
I love flowers too, but I don't know very
much
about them.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Raising things is very difficult. Simply
liking them
isn't enough to make them
grow.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
One needs knowledge, patience, and a
kind
heart—all of which you have,
Flower.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Creek...
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text:
And you'll become even more wonderful
from
here on out. There's no need to
rush.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list:
For now, you still have time to let yourself get
coddled.

text_block_list.text:
See? Even someone who helps
Umamusume grow
for a living says so.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Don't rush. Take your time becoming the

Umamusume you want to be, okay?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Just like how you grow flowers.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Oh...
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text:
Right! I won't rush. I'll take my time...
growing
myself!
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Супер Крик!
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text:
But I feel like Супер Крик might end up
coddling
me a bit too much...
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text:
Well, how about we test that out?
Starting...
with... a... squeeeeeze! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Eep!
text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр

text_block_list.text:
Нишино Флауэр is surprised by Super
Creek's hug,
but smiles happily
nonetheless.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик's encouragement makes
Nishino
Flower break into a smile
reminiscent of a
blooming bud.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
